kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتلعثم (form IIq)
# نَتَلَعْثَمُ (natalaʕṯamu) /na.ta.laʕ.θa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# نَتَلَعْثَمَ (natalaʕṯama) /na.ta.laʕ.θa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# نَتَلَعْثَمْ (natalaʕṯam) /na.ta.laʕ.θam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
